title: Choose the visual world for Voidlynx (Safer Register)
question: You requested a simpler, logo-focused approach. Choose from these highly minimal, clean directions, or stick with the standard Canon.

options.label: The Minimalist Nexus
options.lineage: premium biolink pages and minimalist portfolios
options.thesis: An uncompromisingly simple layout serving as a pure canvas for the Voidlynx logo.
options.viewport: The purple swirl logo centered prominently, with essential links cascading below.
options.risk: Might feel too sparse for a full team website if content grows.

options.label: The Dark Glass Hub
options.thesis: Clean, frosted glass cards over a very subtle dark background.
options.viewport: Logo at the top left, roster and news presented in sleek, translucent cards.
options.risk: A very common trend that might feel a bit generic.

options.label: The Monolithic Monotype
options.lineage: swiss style typography and brutalist posters
options.thesis: Stark contrast, heavy fonts, and absolute simplicity with zero decorative elements.
options.viewport: Massive typography for navigation, with the logo acting as the only visual anchor.
options.risk: Can be polarizing; light mode might not appeal to hardcore gamers.

canonCard.label: The standard esports hub
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, executed impeccably. Think Team Liquid or G2 Esports.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
